reuse.why: Uses the existing db.first access and adds one helper that all five provider link functions call; there was no existing link-validation helper to reuse.

duplication.why: The rule is one function; each of the five copied link functions gains only a one-line call, though the provider literal is repeated next to the one each already writes into account_sync_source.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts with the link functions and runs before findOrCreateBank and any write.

scope.why: Only the guard and its five call sites; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: Clear single query encoding provider, account id, tombstone and the re-link exclusion; adding a provider still requires remembering the call in another copied link function.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All five link functions (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking) call ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic duplicated; the check is one shared function.

one_place.where: ensureBankAccountIsNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called at the start of every provider link function.
